limits: No edit, HTTP write, SDK8 package, generated binding, host integration or vendor/company acceptance has been performed.

Snapshot JSON buffering overhead and production provider/licensing arrangement are not evaluated.

The existing SDK generic edit still serializes revision to whole seconds; no strict write API is supplied and issue 160 remains open until its separate precise-write contract is implemented and proved.

predecessor.status: preserved unadopted prior proof; results apply only to its original bytes

supportedSchema.capability: SDK-created opaque object retains originating sync binding and exposes only ID, generation and revision token. Strict eligibility is revoked synchronously when a replacement attempt starts, including before waiting or server interaction; skips, cancellations and failures cannot restore old proof, and only the latest successful non-overlapped proven sync may publish eligibility. Later writes must revalidate binding, generation, original, token and host lease.
supportedSchema.envelope: Strict sidecar requires every recognized CipherDetails key explicitly present; nonnullable personal identity, type, name, login, revision, creation, permission and status fields must be nonnull; unsupported type payloads, org, collections, archive, deletion, permissions, partial and blob are rejected.
supportedSchema.nested: Explicit known login, URI, custom-field, history and attachment keys only; unknown or duplicate keys disqualify eligibility. Legacy login.uri and nonempty FIDO are rejected; every URI needs a valid checksum, and every attachment needs a nonempty unique ID and successful decrypt.
supportedSchema.revision: Rust-owned published sync snapshot and opaque binding; RFC3339 instant retains chrono nanoseconds. More than nine fractional digits in revisionDate, creationDate, passwordRevisionDate or history lastUsedDate, absent or nil UUID, missing/null required fields and stale or zero generation are rejected.
supportedSchema.totp: Future SDK encryption may normalize an empty TOTP to nil.
